channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Two St. Lucie County cyclospora cases confirmed amid produce outbreak
item.description: Two cases of cyclospora have been confirmed in St. Lucie County since May as part of a wider outbreak linked to contaminated lettuce across the country.

item.title: Waterspout crosses Indian River Lagoon as severe storms batter Treasure Coast
item.description:
A large waterspout passed over the Indian River Lagoon near Sebastian Friday afternoon as severe weather swept across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County. Multiple videos sent to WPTV showed the waterspout moving through the area during the storm system.

item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Treasure Coast residents report five cyclospora cases as produce outbreaks spread
item.description: Two cases in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County are among confirmed local cyclospora infections since May, as contaminated lettuce linked to E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks prompts Treasure Coast families to avoid leafy greens.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent the tablets from running artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey
item.description: A sprawling network of federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies continue with a game plan two years in the making to ensure Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain is safe.

item.title: Messi and Yamal's World Cup final matchup traces back to 2007 photo shoot
item.description: Almost two decades ago, photographer Joan Monfort captured images of teenage Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal in a plastic bathtub for a UNICEF charity calendar. Now they face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England with late goals to advance to World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two goals in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals Wednesday, with Lionel Messi assisting on both late strikes.

item.title: St. Lucie Mets Edge Palm Beach 3-2 in Extra Innings
item.description:

item.description: President Donald Trump's national address on Thursday renewed debate over election security as newly released intelligence records revealed a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter-registration information from commercial websites in 2022. item.title: Leon County jury orders Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 in harassment case
item.description: A jury found the Republican state representative liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation in a case brought by two former staff members and a mother.

item.title: Rep. Angie Nixon gets September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: The Democratic state representative will stand trial on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May protest outside the governor's office over Florida's congressional map.

item.title: South Florida residents change diets as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks spread
item.description: Thousands across the country have been affected by contaminated produce, including lettuce linked to Taco Bell locations, with confirmed cases in Palm Beach, St. Lucie and Martin counties.

item.title: Alex Vindman raises $8.5 million in Florida U.S. Senate race
item.description: The retired Army lieutenant's second-quarter fundraising brings his total receipts above $16 million as he faces Democratic Rep. Angie Nixon in the August primary.

item.title: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces court fight over residency
item.description: Lt. Jay Collins argues records showing Fishback lived and voted in Washington, D.C., mean he does not satisfy Florida's seven-year residency requirement for governor.

item.title: Dietitian recommends vinegar wash for produce during Florida contamination outbreaks
item.description: Delray Medical Center expert says consumers should avoid bagged lettuce and use a 1-to-3 mixture of distilled white vinegar and water to clean fruits and vegetables.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Fort Pierce woman wins $5 million on Florida Lottery scratch-off ticket
item.description:
Maria Duran, 57, of St. Lucie County claimed a $5 million top prize from the $5,000,000 CROSSWORD CASH scratch-off game on April 6, Florida Lottery officials announced Friday. Duran chose to receive her winnings as a one-time, lump-sum payment of $3,262,138.
